message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on 18 June 1815, resulted in roughly **45,000 total casualties**—the sum of killed, wounded, and missing on both sides.  

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French (and allied German contingents) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch‑Prussian coalition | ~20,000 |

These figures are rounded estimates drawn from contemporary reports and modern scholarship; exact numbers vary slightly among sources.
